title: ATP Variable
description: Schema for Agent Task Protocol variable definition files

classification.description: public=structural template only, no real values. private=contains live state, deployment-specific values, or credentials refs. template=placeholder values, ATP repo templates/. All vars with real values are private.

last_verified.description: Legacy date-only authoring metadata. It is not a runtime verification attestation and MUST NOT satisfy freshness after migration to v0.2.

last_verified_at.description: Precise authoring-time verification timestamp. Runtime verification evidence belongs in a separate validation attestation.

verified_by.description: Agent ID or role that last verified this value

staleness_policy.description: always-verify: verify every use. session-cache[:Nm]: once per session, optional N-minute within-session TTL. ttl:Nd: re-verify if older than N days. on-change-only: trust until change event logged.

session_ttl_minutes.description: Within-session TTL override in minutes. Applies to session-cache vars. Overrides the default 120 minutes.

validator.description: Which validator type to apply to verify_cmd output. See lib/validation/validators/ for validator specs.

verify_cmd.description: Shell command to verify current value. Required for always-verify and session-cache policies.

source.description: live=running infrastructure. config=file/config state. derived=computed from other sources.

type.description: requires=hard dependency, blocks loading. enriches=soft dependency, improves context but non-blocking.

depends_on.description: Variables that must be verified before this variable can be used.
